test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 7 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Three electronic bells are fixed in three adjoining temples. The priests of these temples decided to ring the bells at different times with the intervals of 2, 3 and 5 min. If the bells start tolling together for the first time at 8:00:00 in the morning. up to 9:00:00 in the morning they will toll together:
solution:
**Given:**

Priest of 1st temple ring the bells at an interval of 2 minutes 

Priest of 2nd temple ring the bells at an interval of 3 minutes 

Priest of 3rd temple ring the bells at an interval of 5 minutes 

They start tolling for the first time at 8:00:00

Calculati
